basic_info.description: Marina living at its finest. 255 Mallorca is a light-filled, turn-key, remodeled top floor condominium set back from the Street providing privacy and an abundanceof natural light. The open floor plan and sophisticated design maximizes every square foot, highlighted by an oversized living room with a wood burning fireplace, updated chic bathrooms, a formal dining room, two spacious bedrooms, with the primary bedroom opening onto a beautiful sunny deck. In-unit laundry, one car parking, a shared backyard for entertaining, and a 165 square foot bonus room off the garage, perfect for an office or gym, complete this wonderful property and opportunity.
